rationale: C10 plausibly supplied a substantial drafting template. It presents the same Cabinet Committee recommendations later revisited in the child, with closely matching language, subject matter, and ordering: the four tax proposals followed by procurement reform, subcontracting and progress payments, merger and antitrust measures, the SEC-registration threshold, technological aid, and reporting simplification. The child adapts this earlier program summary into a recommendation-by-recommendation status report and adds a revised budgetary judgment. C23 has a notable parallel in the argument against selective tax relief during inadequate revenue conditions, but it does not supply the child's extensive operative structure. C08 provides contextual continuity concerning the same committee but little concrete drafting material.

shared_material.child_excerpt: That businesses be given the right to utilize, for purchases of used property not exceeding $50,000 in any one year, the formulas of accelerated depreciation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: accelerated depreciation for purchases of used property
shared_material.explanation: The same specific tax proposal is restated and expanded with a dollar limitation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: That corporations with, say, ten or fewer stockholders be given the option of being taxed as if they were partnerships.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: an option to any corporation with few stock holders to be taxed as a partnership

shared_material.child_excerpt: That the taxpayer be given the option of paying the estate tax over a period of up to ten years in cases where the estate consists largely of investments in closely held business concerns.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: an option to an estate consisting largely of investments in closely-held business concerns to pay death taxes over a period up to ten years
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive proposal reproduced with nearly identical elements and phrasing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a comprehensive review of procurement policies and procedures of all departments and agencies, including the legislation pertaining thereto, with a view to facilitating and extending the participation of small businesses in work on Government contracts
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a comprehensive review of procurement policies, procedures and legislation, with a view to increasing small business' share in government contracts
shared_material.explanation: Close language describing the same review machinery and objective.

shared_material.child_excerpt: legislation be enacted to enable closer Federal scrutiny of mergers ... procedural changes be made in the antitrust laws to facilitate their enforcement
shared_material.parent_excerpt: legislation to enable closer scrutiny by the Department of Justice of proposed mergers; and procedural changes in the anti-trust laws to facilitate enforcement
shared_material.explanation: The two linked recommendations appear in the same sequence and substantially the same words.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the maximum amount of an issue of corporate securities which the Securities and Exchange Commission may exempt from registration be increased from $300,000 to $500,000
shared_material.parent_excerpt: raising the existing statutory exemption from S. E. C. registration, from $300,000 to $500,000
shared_material.explanation: Identical administrative change with the same precise thresholds.

shared_material.child_excerpt: wage reporting by employers for purposes of social security records and income tax withholding be simplified ... a comprehensive review of the reports and statistics required of small businesses
shared_material.parent_excerpt: simplification of statistical and other reports to government, including wage-reporting for Social Security records and income tax withholding
shared_material.explanation: The child separates and reports the status of reporting reforms that C10 summarized together.
